conclusion: No concrete source-level CI/input blocker found in the reviewed bytes. Actual Windows installer execution and report acceptance remain pending.

checks.observed: Existing setup pins pnpm10.30.3, Node24.22.2 and action commit SHAs, installs the frozen pnpm lock, and selects CPython3.14 x64. Python patch version is selected by setup-python, not fixed by this workflow. Integration wheel URLs/hashes target cp314-win_amd64, compatible abi3-win_amd64, or platform-independent wheels.

Manifest pins MinGit2.53.0.windows.1 and GitHub CLI2.87.3 archive SHA256 values. New staging verifies archive and every copied file byte count/hash, handles the declared GH archive root, and runs existing collectGitTools before packaging.

python:true provides both isolated dependency roots and HARNESS_HERMES_PYTHON. Existing packaging requires CPython3.14 Windows x64, verifies source/dependency custody, relocates Python, compiles the credential lease using pinned Node headers/library and Visual Studio C++ tools, and verifies relocated payloads.

Locked electron-builder26.18.0/app-builder-lib26.18.0 resolves its NSIS compiler/resources through declared hashed toolsets. Existing config targets x64 per-user NSIS, useZip:true, no elevation, no code-signing requirement, no automatic launch after install.

Packaging output-root matches verifier resolution of desktop-release-${version}, Gen-V1-Setup-${version}-win-x64.exe and win-unpacked. Resolve-Path provides absolute paths; the HARNESS_INSTALLED_VERIFY_ARGV JSON marker records the same array passed to pnpm, followed by explicit LASTEXITCODE propagation.
Verifier connects Playwright Chromium client to the owned installed Electron debug endpoint with connectOverCDP; it does not launch a downloaded Playwright Chromium binary.

Pinned upload-artifact action runs always with include-hidden-files:true. Explicit globs retain build manifest, owned-install metadata, verification reports, PNGs, redacted memory export and packaged-provider report. Profile/source DB trees are not selected.

limitations: No Windows installer execution is claimed by this review.
No live account, provider inference, enabled memory rollout, or installed default-on acceptance is claimed.
Future CI receipt must bind all nine jobs to its actual published head and merge checkout; earlier eight-job runs do not cover this job.
